decisions.reason: A burner component for radiant heaters sits at the core of the firm's established gas infrared know-how, so its in-house engineering can readily assimilate feedback and refine it, even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The electric infrared panel heater extends the firm's radiant heating expertise into electrification and has its own product page, so the firm can interpret its early results well and keep it.
The halogen infrared heater builds on established radiant heat knowledge and serves outdoor and hall niches, so related knowledge and in-house development support keeping it.
The industrial electric hall heater is very close to the core offer for industrial halls, fits the electrification trend, and is fully presented, so it is well within the firm's absorptive capacity.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is the strategic low-carbon product, is close to the core gas technology, and already runs in a real-world pilot, giving the R&D team valuable data to learn from.
